tierName: SEQUENCE A: Hotel leadership and operational owners
targetPersonas: Hotel Managers, General Managers, Hotel Directors, and local owners actively involved in running the hotel and making purchasing decisions.
messagingAngle: Explore upcoming tableware replenishment, replacement or refurbishment needs across hotel restaurants, breakfast service and banqueting. Introduce DukeGroup’s professional tableware portfolio and invite a brief conversation about the hotel’s plans.

emails.subject: Tableware for {{company}}
emails.body:
Dear {{first_name}},
I’m reaching out to ask whether you are planning to replenish or update the tableware for your hotel restaurant, breakfast service or other dining areas in the coming months.

At DukeGroup, we specialise in professional tableware for hotels. We represent brands such as FIGGJO and SERAX and help select porcelain, glassware, cutlery and other items to suit each hotel’s needs and concept.

Would you be open to a brief conversation about your plans and how we could work together?

Best regards,
{{signature}}

emails.subject: RE: Tableware for {{company}}
emails.body:
Dear {{first_name}},
I recently wrote to you about tableware for your hotel.

A conversation could also be useful if you are simply planning to replenish existing stock or select new items for a particular part of your offering, such as breakfast, the restaurant or banqueting.

Based on your needs, I could present a focused selection of products from our portfolio.

Are any of these purchases currently on your agenda?

Best regards,
{{signature}}

emails.subject: RE: Tableware for {{company}}
emails.body:
Dear {{first_name}},

I’m getting back in touch to see whether selecting or replenishing tableware is currently relevant for your hotel.

If so, we could arrange a brief conversation. If a colleague manages this area, I would appreciate being pointed in the right direction.

If you are planning purchases for a later date, please let me know when it would be a good time to reconnect.

Best regards,

{{signature}}

tierName: SEQUENCE B: F&B managers and Executive Chefs

emails.subject: Tableware for your hotel restaurant
emails.body:
Dear {{first_name}},

I’m reaching out to ask whether you are planning to add to your tableware selection or explore new ways to present dishes in your hotel restaurant.

At DukeGroup, we work with international professional tableware brands, including FIGGJO and SERAX. We help select items based on your style of service, food presentation and team’s needs.

Would a brief conversation about what could be relevant for your restaurant be useful?

Best regards,

{{signature}}

emails.subject: RE: Tableware for your hotel restaurant
emails.body:
Dear {{first_name}},

I’m following up on my message about tableware for your restaurant.

Alongside plates and other items, we can also present FIGGJO’s customised decor options if you would like to reflect your hotel or restaurant’s visual identity in your tableware.

If you let me know which part of your tableware selection you would like to add to, I can put together a few relevant suggestions for review.

Would this be useful for any upcoming purchases?

Best regards,

{{signature}}

emails.subject: RE: Tableware for your hotel restaurant
emails.body:
Dear {{first_name}},

I’m getting back in touch to see whether a conversation about tableware for your restaurant would be useful at the moment.

If you select items together with procurement or hotel management, the relevant colleague could also join the conversation.

If now is not the right time, I would be grateful to know when you usually plan tableware replenishment.

Best regards,

{{signature}}
